desc:
⛓️ ESCAPE the mental asylum or 👮 CONTROL the CHAOS 

Welcome to 🏥 OAKLAND PSYCHIATRIC FACILITY, a realistic mental asylum roleplay!

🩹 PATIENTS: take your meds, go to therapy, earn credits.. and PLAN YOUR ESCAPE!
🦹 ESCAPEES: Help other patients in the asylum escape and CAUSE CHAOS!
👮 SECURITY: Escort patients, run the checkpoint, cuff troublemakers, and RESPOND TO RIOTS!
🩺 DOCTORS: Treat injuries w/ bandages, splints, read ECGs, use the AED, and SAVE LIVES!
🔧 CREW: Cook meals, clean, restock supplies, and REPAIR THE FACILITY!

✨ FEATURES
• Wounds, bleeding, and cardiac arrest
• Psychiatric conditions that change how you see the world
• Laptops, keycard doors and lockdowns
• Proximity chat: talk to the people near you

/ooc to talk out of character & /advert for adverts
